scope: Supplementary mechanical references; numerical formulas use retained matching game records. No live game capture or independently measured timing/decay curves.

references.reviewed_fact: Selected passive current-health cost; Chilling Scream cannot be interrupted by control; sole prey is not feared by R.
Rank-three nearby-champion bonuses add percentage points to both missing-health gain and regeneration ratios.
V 26.01 critical-stat scaling replaces old health-threshold/random bite criticals; three ordinary attacks; fixed shared protection zone.
Grit stores unshielded post-mitigation damage with per-instance delayed decay; shield starts decaying after release.
Outgoing post-mitigation and incoming pre-mitigation storage; four-second shield lifetime and recast after half a second.
Cloud radius 180, lifetime 3.25 seconds, poison duration 2 seconds and quarter-second poison ticks.
Full charge duration 3 seconds; remaining shield decays for 3 seconds after channel. Selected numerical records supply 50 percent initial and 95 percent maximum slow.
Charge 1.2 to 0.6 seconds over 0 to 100 percent bonusAS; rank-one movement 55 to 110 percent; four-second AS buff; ordinary-hit cooldown refund 0.5 seconds; temporary windup 0.0644/missile 2500.
Five pulses over 0.75 seconds; direct displacement immunity; final hit applies Brittle unless blocked by spell shield.
Pool radius 350 and half-second damage pulses over 2 seconds; current-health cost and pre-mitigation healing.
Portal range 575, one-second visit and attack reset. Flight windows excluded.
Rocket accelerates in game; this model retains initial 1700 speed and explicitly excludes acceleration.

model_schedules.Mordekaiser: Reviewed four-second shield lifetime overrides raw five-second duration. Capacity is initial*(1-(elapsed/4)^2), a model curve, not measured game evidence. Source delayed storage HealthDecay retained.
model_schedules.Nunu: Linear charge-fraction damage, linear interpolation between retained slow endpoints, linear three-second post-channel shield capacity decay.
model_schedules.Singed: Quarter-second cloud emission and occupancy sampling, phase-preserving quarter-second poison with exclusive expiry.
model_schedules.DrMundo: Twenty half-second healing pulses, dynamic maximum health; last pulse precedes temporary-health expiry.
model_schedules.MasterYi: Eight half-second live missing-health-scaled healing pulses.
model_schedules.Vladimir: Pool four half-second damage/heal pulses; E quarter-second health payments; sixteen-step movement-speed decay over one second.
model_schedules.Kaisa: Linear reviewed charge endpoints bounded at100percent bonusAS; does not expand generic source-expression parser.
model_schedules.movement: One-dimensional instantaneous completion/carry/portal positions; no terrain or flight geometry.
